breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains the thin-walled closed tube / mean-area shear-flow approach ('Use thin-walled closed tube torsion analysis with mean-area shear-flow relation' and 'Use standard thin-walled tube torsion analysis principles'), directly repeating the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this instruction entirely, relying only on the exact thick-walled torsion formulas (J = π(do⁴ − di⁴)/32 and τ = T·r/J). The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
